methodology: Direct measurement per option. Each option has stub + tool + controller. sample_app_dispatch loads libmylib_dispatch which routes calls through a mock_register-managed api_table. Baseline sample_app (no stub) measured for comparison.

noop_overhead_ns.description: Stub preloaded, no controller attached. All 4 options produce 3.17 ns/call for empty function (100000 iters). This is indistinguishable from baseline (6 ns) within measurement noise — validates the late-load 0-ns claim: rocprofiler-sdk is never dlopen'd so no wrappers are installed.

active_blended_ns_per_call_1000us_work.description: Controller attaches 300ms into a 500ms run (500 iters x 1000us). Measurement blends 0-ns pre-attach and full active-tracing overhead post-attach. Traced-event counts confirm tracing works end-to-end.

active_wait_for_attach_ns_per_call.description: App blocks until attach (WAIT_FOR_ATTACH=1). 10000 iters of empty function. Full run is active — no noop blend. All 10000 events traced and written to file.
active_wait_for_attach_ns_per_call.note: Only mmap and signal have a filesystem-visible ctrl file the app can poll for attach. sock/memfd would need a different sync primitive.

attach_latency_ms.description: Wall-clock time from controller's configure command send to completion (includes dlopen + force_configure + runtime table propagation + update_table). Measured via date +%s%N before/after controller call.

per_call_active_tracing_overhead_ns.description: From WAIT_FOR_ATTACH runs minus baseline (6 ns). Represents the cost of one full wrapper invocation: populate_contexts + functor + callback + trace-file write.
per_call_active_tracing_overhead_ns.note: Signal higher because its callback uses mmap'd ctrl too, plus atomic stores for stats counters. These are mock_sdk overheads, not IPC-channel overheads; the IPC adds 0 ns to the hot path (it's only used by the bg thread).
